metadata.title: सावधान ! जंगल में ज़हरीले खाने को कैसे पहचानें ।How to find wild tuber in Jungle।The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we take you to the jungles of Dediapada in Gujarat. We went into the jungle with people from the Vasava tribe, who showed us how to identify this wild tuber (जंगली कांदा). Surprisingly, a tuber that is sweet is poisonous, while the bitter one is healthy for you.
